component.name: one·mk
component.summary: Share one mouse and keyboard between your computers

description.p: one·mk moves your mouse and keyboard from one computer to the next when the pointer crosses the edge of the screen, and shares the clipboard and files between them. It is a small, encrypted, peer-to-peer program for Linux, macOS and Windows.
Pair two computers once, and they find each other on the local network from then on.
